name: The Muddy Boots
description: A pair of mud-caked boots stands by a door, a trail of dark footprints leading away.

name: The Cracked Spectacles on Wolf
description: A pair of spectacles with one cracked lens lies on wolf.

name: The Brown Bottle
description: A small apothecary bottle and few bloody letters.

name: The Compass and Map
description: A brass compass rests on a torn map marked by hand.

name: The Old Radio
description: An old radio with its back panel open and its wires pulled loose.

name: The Newspaper Clipping
description: A yellowed newspaper page with one headline circled in pencil.

name: The Ledger
description: A ledger lies open at a page with one entry torn out.

name: The Torn Page
description: A numbered sheet of paper marked with the number 12.

name: The Briefcase
description: A worn briefcase left behind, its contents no longer accounted for.

name: The Hammer
description: A heavy hammer abandoned on the ground.

name: The Cigarette
description: A cigarette and its remains lie in an old ashtray.

name: The Creature and the Lantern
description: A strange silhouette appears beyond the trees, beside a small light.

name: The Flower on the Board
description: A pale flower has been placed carefully on a dark board.

name: The Wooden Boards
description: A message has been scratched into a set of old wooden boards.

name: The Rainbow
description: A rainbow stretches across a distant, storm-dark landscape.

name: The Pocket Watch
description: An old pocket watch rests among papers and books.

name: The Wall Lantern
description: A lit lantern hangs from a cold stone wall.

name: The Bandage
description: A used bandage is wrapped around an injured arm.

name: The Playing Cards
description: Several playing cards have been scattered across the floor.

name: The Cap and Lollipop
description: A small cap and a brightly coloured lollipop have been left together.

name: The Camera
description: An old camera lies abandoned among debris.

name: The Skeleton
description: A human skeleton lies arranged on an old examination table.

name: The Ice
description: A small stack of ice blocks glistens in the dim light.

name: The Handcuffs and Books
description: A pair of handcuffs rests beside a stack of old books.

name: The Sword
description: A sword has been left among scattered tools and debris.

name: The Microphone
description: A microphone stands alone in a dark, abandoned room.

name: The Screwdriver and Sandwich
description: A screwdriver and an unfinished sandwich lie side by side.

name: The Armour
description: A suit of armour stands in a forgotten stone chamber.

name: The Wig and Spray
description: A dark wig and a can of spray have been left behind.

name: The Letter and Glass
description: A sealed letter lies beside a drinking glass.

name: The Whistle and Ball
description: A whistle and a ball have been abandoned together.

name: The Board of Photographs
description: A crowded board of photographs is connected with red string.

name: The Gloves
description: A pair of worn gloves rests beside a cut lemon.

name: The Scarf and Bullets
description: A scarf lies beside several loose rounds of ammunition.

name: The Treasure Chest
description: An open chest reveals a collection of old treasure.

name: The Hidden Eggs
description: A clutch of eggs has been concealed among tangled roots.

name: The SOS Message
description: A distress message has been written on a worn sheet.

name: The Plate
description: An old decorative plate rests on a dusty table.

name: The Mirror
description: A mirror left behind, reflecting something that may no longer be there.

name: The Rope and Key
description: A length of rope and a key have been found together.
